summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by ensuring that single-child Q objects are only treated as keyword arguments if they are length-2 tuples, which prevents the TypeError when the child is not subscriptable.

issues.description: The change might introduce behavioral regression risk by altering how single-child Q objects are deconstructed, even though the original behavior was undocumented. It's possible that some code relies on the current behavior, although it's unlikely.
